# Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (x64)

- Vendor: Microsoft Corporation
- Not bundled: downloaded with PHP when the runtime is missing (https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe, Microsoft Authenticode signature verified) into `data\modules\vcredist\`
- Purpose: runtime libraries required by the official PHP Windows build; the app starts Microsoft's installer with administrator rights after asking.
- License: Microsoft Software License Terms for the Visual C++ Redistributable; redistribution is permitted as part of an application
  (see the "Distributable Code" terms of Visual Studio: https://learn.microsoft.com/visualstudio/releases/2022/redistribution).

The license terms are shown by the installer itself (`vc_redist.x64.exe`).
